CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feedback_form_is_public(f feedback_forms)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select case f.profile_space
    when 'alias' then exists (
      select 1 from public.alias_profiles a join public.profiles p on p.id = a.user_id
      where a.user_id = f.user_id and a.handle = f.profile_handle and a.enabled
        and coalesce((a.display_prefs->>'publicProfile')::boolean, true)
        and not coalesce(p.is_banned,false) and not coalesce(p.is_suspended,false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.patch_workspace_profile_draft(p_workspace_id uuid, p_fields jsonb, p_prefs jsonb, p_drop_prefs text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(revision bigint, published_revision bigint, updated_at timestamp with time zone, published_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fields jsonb := coalesce(p_fields, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_prefs jsonb := coalesce(p_prefs, '{}'::jsonb);
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(v_fields) <> 'object' or jsonb_typeof(v_prefs) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'validation: draft patch must be an object';
  end if;

  return query
    update public.workspace_profile_drafts d
       set payload = (d.payload || (v_fields - 'displayPrefs' - 'username'))
             || jsonb_build_object(
               'displayPrefs',
               ((case when jsonb_typeof(d.payload -> 'displayPrefs') = 'object'
                      then d.payload -> 'displayPrefs' else '{}'::jsonb end)
                 - coalesce(p_drop_prefs, '{}'::text[]))
               || v_prefs
             ),
           revision = d.revision + 1,
           updated_by = public.rout_current_user_id(),
           updated_at = now()
     where d.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    returning d.revision, d.published_revision, d.updated_at, d.published_at;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'draft_not_found';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publish_profile_draft(p_user_id uuid, p_space text, p_expected_revision bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(revision bigint, published_revision bigint, published_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_payload jsonb;
  v_revision bigint;
begin
  select d.payload, d.revision into v_payload, v_revision
    from public.profile_drafts d
   where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space
   for update;

  if v_payload is null or v_revision <> p_expected_revision then
    raise exception 'draft_conflict';
  end if;

  if p_space = 'verified' then
    update public.profiles set
      username = v_payload->>'username',
      display_name = nullif(v_payload->>'displayName', ''),
      tagline = nullif(v_payload->>'tagline', ''),
      avatar_url = nullif(v_payload->>'avatarUrl', ''),
      favicon_url = nullif(v_payload->>'faviconUrl', ''),
      theme = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'theme', ''), 'noir'),
      card_style = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'cardStyle', ''), 'bordered'),
      blocks = coalesce(v_payload->'blocks', '[]'::jsonb),
      display_prefs = coalesce(v_payload->'displayPrefs', '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = p_user_id;
    if not found then raise exception 'profile_not_found'; end if;
  elsif p_space = 'alias' then
    update public.alias_profiles set
      handle = v_payload->>'username',
      display_name = nullif(v_payload->>'displayName', ''),
      tagline = nullif(v_payload->>'tagline', ''),
      avatar_url = nullif(v_payload->>'avatarUrl', ''),
      favicon_url = nullif(v_payload->>'faviconUrl', ''),
      theme = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'theme', ''), 'noir'),
      card_style = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'cardStyle', ''), 'bordered'),
      blocks = coalesce(v_payload->'blocks', '[]'::jsonb),
      display_prefs = coalesce(v_payload->'displayPrefs', '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = now()
    where user_id = p_user_id;
    if not found then raise exception 'profile_not_found'; end if;
  else
    raise exception 'draft_space_invalid';
  end if;

  update public.profile_drafts d
     set published_revision = d.revision, published_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space;

  return query
    select d.revision, d.published_revision, d.published_at
      from public.profile_drafts d
     where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space;
end;
$function$

      union all select 'https://rout.be/' || p.username
      union all select 'https://' || case
        when p.subdomain_tier='root_lifetime' and p.root_subdomain_status='active' then p.username || '.rout.be'
        when p.subdomain_tier in ('root_lifetime','pro') then p.username || '.r.rout.be'

  join public.users u on u.id=p.id

    and i.verify_code like 'relme:%' and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
    and p.username is not null and coalesce(p.is_banned,false)=false
    and coalesce(p.is_suspended,false)=false

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_presence_public(p_handle text, p_space text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare o record; blocks jsonb; result jsonb;
begin
 select * into o from public.rout_qa_owner(p_handle,p_space);
 if o.owner_id is null then return '[]'::jsonb; end if;
 if p_space='alias' then select a.blocks into blocks from public.alias_profiles a where a.user_id=o.owner_id;
 else select p.blocks into blocks from public.profiles p where p.id=o.owner_id; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.data order by s.at),'[]'::jsonb) into result from (
  select q.answered_at as at,jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'statusType','qa_reply','question',q.body,'answer',q.answer,'createdAt',q.answered_at,'expiresAt',q.story_until) as data
  from public.profile_questions q where q.owner_id=o.owner_id and q.space=p_space and q.published
   and q.answer is not null and not q.is_quarantined and q.story_until>now()
  union all
  select e.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'statusType','micro_text','text',e.content_payload->>'text','theme',coalesce(e.content_payload->>'theme','aurora'),'bg',e.content_payload->>'bg','font',e.content_payload->>'font','align',e.content_payload->>'align','sticker',e.content_payload->>'sticker','createdAt',e.created_at,'expiresAt',e.expires_at)
  from public.ephemeral_statuses e where e.user_id=o.owner_id and e.space=p_space and e.status_type='micro_text' and e.expires_at>now()
  union all
  select e.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'statusType','omni_drop','blockId',b->>'id','title',coalesce(i->>'caption',b->>'label'),'targetUrl',coalesce(i->>'targetUrl',b->>'value'),'mediaUrl',coalesce(i->>'mediaUrl',b->>'thumbnailUrl'),'badge',b->>'badge','createdAt',e.created_at,'expiresAt',e.expires_at)
  from public.ephemeral_statuses e
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(blocks,'[]'::jsonb)) b
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when b->>'kind'='social_grid' then coalesce((b->>'value')::jsonb->'items','[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end) i on i->>'id'=e.content_payload->>'itemId'
  where e.user_id=o.owner_id and e.space=p_space and e.status_type='omni_drop' and e.expires_at>now()
   and b->>'id'=e.content_payload->>'blockId' and coalesce((b->>'hidden')::boolean,false)=false
   and (nullif(b->>'startsAt','') is null or (b->>'startsAt')::timestamptz<=now())
   and (nullif(b->>'expiresAt','') is null or (b->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz>now())
   and (not(e.content_payload ? 'itemId') or i is not null)
  order by at desc limit 30
 ) s;
 return result;
end $function$

     and coalesce(p.is_banned, false) = false

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_qa_public(p_handle text, p_space text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare o record; v_show boolean;
begin
  select * into o from public.rout_qa_owner(p_handle, p_space);
  if o.owner_id is null then return null; end if;
  v_show := coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaShowAvatar')::boolean, true);
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'accepting', coalesce((o.prefs->>'questionsEnabled')::boolean, false),
    'onHub', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaOnHub')::boolean, true),
    'page', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaPage')::boolean, false),
    'promptKey', o.prefs->>'qaPrompt', 'promptCustom', o.prefs->>'qaPromptCustom',
    'displayName', o.display_name,
    'avatarUrl', case when v_show then o.avatar_url end,
    'audience', coalesce(o.prefs->>'qaAudience', 'members_only'),
    'showAvatar', v_show,
    'showProfileLink', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaShowProfileLink')::boolean, true),
    'design', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb)
      from jsonb_each(coalesce(o.prefs, '{}'::jsonb))
      where key in ('themeOverrides', 'buttonVariant', 'buttonRadius', 'buttonColor',
        'buttonTextColor', 'buttonSize', 'fontPairing', 'buttonsCustom', 'typographyCustom',
        'glassStyle', 'glassOpacity', 'glassBlur', 'glassBorder', 'glassTargets')),
    'qaLevel', (select to_jsonb(u)->>'qa_permission_level' from public.users u where u.id=o.owner_id),
    'answers', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',q.id,'body',q.body,'answer',q.answer,'prompt',q.prompt,
      'answeredAt',q.answered_at,'storyUntil',q.story_until) order by q.answered_at desc)
      from (select id,body,answer,prompt,answered_at,story_until from public.profile_questions
        where owner_id=o.owner_id and space=p_space and published and answer is not null
          and not is_quarantined order by answered_at desc limit 30) q), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end $function$

        'scanned_at', s.scanned_at, 'country', s.country,
        'device', s.device, 'browser', s.browser, 'os', s.os
      ) order by s.scanned_at desc)
      from public.qr_scans s where s.tracked_qr_id = q.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) end
  from public.tracked_qrs q
  where q.dashboard_token = _token
  limit 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workspace_may_drop_suffix(ws_plan text, ws uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    select coalesce(ws_plan, 'free') in ('plus', 'pro', 'business')
      or exists (select 1 from public.entitlement_overrides o
                  where o.scope_type = 'workspace' and o.scope_id = ws
                    and o.entitlement_key = 'WORKSPACE_PLAN' and o.value in ('plus', 'pro', 'business'))
      or exists (select 1 from public.workspace_members m
                   join public.entitlement_overrides o
                     on o.scope_type = 'user' and o.scope_id = m.user_id
                    and o.entitlement_key = 'PRO_FOR_LIFE' and o.value = 'true'
                  where m.workspace_id = ws and m.role = 'owner')
  $function$
